title: GCE Officer (I) (LtCol to 2ndLt) FMOS, DC PP&O
raw_text:
7.     MOS 8008, GCE Officer (I) (LtCol to 2ndLt) FMOS, DC PP&O

    a. Summary. This MOS will be used in T/Os to designate a billet to
which an Unrestricted Ground Combat Arms Officer may be assigned but will not
be assigned to an individual.

    b. Prerequisites. Must possess as a primary MOS either MOS 0302,
Infantry Officer, 0370, Marine Raider Officer, 0802, Field Artillery Officer,
1302, Combat Engineer, 1802, Tank Officer, or 1803, Assault Amphibious
Vehicle Officer. Officers with NMOS 0307, Expeditionary Ground Reconnaissance
Officer, are also eligible.

       c.   Requirements.     None.

       d.   Duties.   None.

    e. Related Standard Occupational Classification (SOC) Title and Code.
Officer Military Training/Reporting/Special Duty Code (no related SOC) 00-
0002.

       f.   Related Military Skill.     None.
